fees.notes: International fee not published: programme is not listed with an international fee on StudyMalaysia and MSU official pages publish Malaysian fees only. Source: https://www.msu.edu.my (accessed 2026-09-18).

requirements.general: STPM with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in any two (2) subjects or equivalent; OR STAM with a minimum grade of Jayyid or equivalent; OR Matriculation/Foundation with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 or equivalent; OR Diploma (Level 4, MQF) with a minimum CGPA of 2.00 or equivalent; OR Adult learners with working experience with related APEL-A certification.
